description: Find federal court rules by words in their title, e.g. "summary judgment" (FRCP 56), "hearsay" (FRE 801-807), "notice of appeal" (FRAP), "discovery". Matches rule titles and numbers only, not the full rule text. Searches one set, or all five when set is omitted. Returns rule numbers and titles; call get_federal_rule for the text.

query.description: Words from the rule title, e.g. "seizing property", "business records".

set.description: Rule set: frcp (Civil Procedure), fre (Evidence), frap (Appellate), frcrp (Criminal Procedure), frbp (Bankruptcy). Aliases such as frcrmp and "civil" are accepted. Omit to search all sets.

name: search_federal_rules
title: Search Federal Rules
